title: Address PR #105 review: sanitize failed-turn result errors
description: Review source: PR #105 non-blocking feedback. Requirement: runTurn failed results must redact secret-bearing error substrings using the same sanitizer as persisted turn_failure_diagnostic records, so CLI output via result.error is sanitized without duplicating regex logic.
